name: KCubing Winter 2017

venue.name: First Raytown Baptist
venue.details: Enter in the cafe, turn right at the Gym, and the room will be on your left.

information: Registration Info Registration is $12 for each competitor (includes 3x3) and an additional $2 for each event other than 3x3. Late fee will be charged starting Feburary 22nd. Late fee will be $15 for each competitor (includes 3x3) and $4 for each event after that. When you sign up, it will put you on the waiting list. If there are not 85 competitors registered, I'm awaiting payment via paypal (see the registration tab for more info) Spectators get in free. No walk in competitors. **lunch** Pizza will be served for $2 a slice. Thank you to TheCubicle.us for sponsoring this competition. Consider checking them out next time you want to order a puzzle. [Directions](https://www.google.com/maps/dir//10500+E+State+Rte+350,+Raytown,+MO+64138/@38.9849374,-94.4588741,17z/data=!4m13!1m4!3m3!1s0x87c0e161caee72d1:0x83aaab1c75d39d09!2s10500+E+State+Rte+350,+Raytown,+MO+64138!3b1!4m7!1m0!1m5!1m1!1s0x87c0e161caee72d1:0x83aaab1c75d39d09!2m2!1d-94.4566854!2d38.9849374) on google maps.
